lines.text: The LORD says a man cannot hide in secret places, because He fills the heavens and the earth.
The LORD has heard prophets who prophesy lies in His name saying they had a dream, as their fathers forgot His name through Moloch.
The LORD says the prophet with a dream may retell it, and His word is like fire and a hammer that smashes a rock.
The LORD is against the prophets who steal words from one another, and He says He did not send those who prophesy false dreams.
When asked about the burden of the LORD, the answer is that He will forsake them, and He will punish the man and his household.
